summary: Inhibikase Therapeutics disclosed a press release announcing the sale of 25 million shares at-market to RA Capital Management for $50 million gross proceeds under an existing ATM facility. This is a routine capital raise under an effective shelf registration, not a transformative event. There are no special-situation elements such as a takeover, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring. The filing simply reports an ordinary at-the-market equity issuance to fund operations.
